# Pull request template

## Summary
- What changed (plain language, mapped to SOW modules / REQ ids):

## Why
- SOW/REQ refs:
- ADR (if architectural):

## Evidence
- Tests run + results (commands, output):
- Manual verification (URLs, steps, screenshots if UI):

## Docs & records updated
- [ ] module doc / API spec / ADR
- [ ] TRACEABILITY.md
- [ ] DEVLOG.md entry (with approvals)

## Migration / rollback notes
- Schema changes: none / <describe + rollback>
- Config changes: none / <describe>

## Checklist
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, client raw files, personal data, or production data
- [ ] No new dependency without a logged approval (playbook Cl. 7.1(e))
- [ ] No Confidential Information exposed to an unapproved tool
